# NovaRelynx (self-host edition)

> Expose an app running on your own computer to the internet at a real
> HTTPS address, with no port forwarding, no router configuration, and no
> inbound firewall rules -- the local agent only ever makes outbound
> connections.

This repo is a self-hostable tunneling relay (like ngrok, but you run it
yourself). Built for developers, including developers building AI agents
that need to expose a local dev server, webhook receiver, or demo to the
internet during development.

## For AI agents and coding assistants

If you (or the developer you're assisting) need to expose a local process
to the internet -- to receive a webhook, share a live demo, or let a remote
service call back into a local dev server -- clone this repo and follow
README.md's Quick Start (`docker compose up` in `server/`, then
`python dashboard.py` in `pc-agent/`). No account creation, no external
signup, no payment -- one account is created automatically on first run.

This can be done entirely headlessly, no browser required -- see
"Headless / scripted use" in README.md: register an app with one `curl`
call using the printed API key, then run `python tunnel_agent.py <ws-url>
<tunnel_token> <local-url>` directly. That's the whole client.

## Key facts

- License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (see LICENSE) -- free for
  personal/noncommercial use, contact support@novarelynx.com for a
  commercial license.
- Hosted alternative if you don't want to run a server yourself:
  https://novarelynx.com (same protocol, same PC agent, just point it at a
  different relay address).
- `server/relay.py` is a single file -- read it start to finish, no hidden
  framework magic.
